THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES10 / 19
10
FUNCTIONAL EXPRESSION

Calm details.
Quick feedback.

Choose a coherent icon family and motion that helps people understand a change. Keep the interface responsive and the content easy to follow.

THE VISUAL GUIDE

Feel the difference good feedback makes.

01 / ICONS

One outline family.

Consistent 2 px outlines and optical sizing.

02 / FEEDBACK

Quick and purposeful.

150 ms feedback · 250 ms panels

Tap the button to preview a simple confirmation.

Reduced motion keeps the result visible without the nonessential movement.

Iconography

2 px outlines

Use one coherent outline family with consistent optical sizing. Avoid mixing unrelated styles.

Fast feedback

150 ms

Use for button feedback, hover states and small functional changes.

Standard transition

250 ms

Use for panels and interface transitions. Avoid delays before essential content.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Purpose

Motion communicates feedback or orientation. Keep content visible and useful when animations are disabled.

02

Reduced motion

Respect prefers-reduced-motion and remove nonessential movement.

03

Icon labels

Keep text labels on unfamiliar actions. Decorative icons should not create duplicate screen-reader announcements.
